params.label: Cube depth
params.note: How far half a turn of the cube moves each of its knobs, as a share of the knob's range. Below zero it pulls them down.

params.label: Tilt depth
params.note: How far a 35 degree tilt moves each knob, as a share of its range.

params.label: Kick box depth
params.note: How far a ball at the top of the box moves its knob, as a share of the knob's range.

params.label: Kick force
params.note: How hard each kick throws the balls off the floor.

params.label: Lorenz depth
params.note: How far the attractor's swing moves each knob, as a share of its range.

params.label: Chaos
params.note: Lorenz's rho, from 12 (it spirals in and the knobs come to rest) past 24.7 (the edge of chaos) to 42 (wild).

params.label: Lorenz speed
params.note: How fast the attractor runs: at 35 % one loop takes about two bars.

params.label: Gyro depth
params.note: How far each ring's swing moves its knob, as a share of the knob's range.

params.label: Steps depth
params.note: How far a full step moves its knob, as a share of the knob's range.

params.label: Steps glide
params.note: 0: each 16th jumps. Higher: the steps slide into each other.
